title: Win probability from the score and the time left
intro: Illustrative data, made up for this book: the sizes and patterns are realistic, the teams and players are not real. A basketball team leads by 6 points with 8 minutes left. The final margin is modelled as normal: mean = the current lead, standard deviation = 2.2 points × √(minutes left) = 6.22. P(final margin > 0) is the win probability (ties ignored).
